environment_note: Every host below resolves to an address in 198.18.0.0/15 (RFC 2544 benchmarking range), i.e. DNS is intercepted by the execution sandbox. Reachability therefore reflects a sandbox proxy allowlist, NOT public internet availability of these sites. Unreachability recorded here is an ACCESS LIMITATION of this environment and is not evidence that the documentation does not exist.

sources.authority: Audit Organization of Iran (سازمان حسابرسی) - codified standards portal

sources.authority: Iranian Association / Society of Certified Public Accountants (IACPA, جامعه حسابداران رسمی ایران)
sources.establishes: IACPA is an IFAC member body. Its site does NOT itself publish the audit-opinion taxonomy; it links out to the Audit Organization codified-standards portal at audit.org.ir for 'استانداردهای حسابرسی' (auditing standards).
sources.does_not_establish: does not provide any allowed-category list for a structured audit-opinion field, and does not describe any CODAL field schema

sources.authority: International Auditing and Assurance Standards Board (IAASB), published via IFAC
sources.relevant_section: Scope of this ISA, para 1; Types of Modified Opinions, para 2; Effective Date, para 3
sources.verbatim_key_text: This ISA establishes three types of modified opinions, namely, a qualified opinion, an adverse opinion, and a disclaimer of opinion.
sources.effective_date_text: This ISA is effective for audits of financial statements for periods ending on or after December 15, 2016.
sources.establishes: The international standard's exact modified-opinion taxonomy: qualified, adverse, disclaimer. With ISA 700 (Revised)'s unmodified opinion this is a four-category structure.
does_not_establish: Iranian adoption of this taxonomy verbatim
existence of a CODAL structured audit-opinion field
the exact machine-readable category identifiers CODAL would use
the Persian term to category mapping as encoded by CODAL

sources.authority: secondary reference material (encyclopedic); consulted only to characterise the calendar's definitional nature
sources.establishes: The Solar Hijri calendar is described as observational: the year begins at the midnight nearest the vernal equinox as determined astronomically at the Iranian reference meridian, and leap-year placement follows the actual equinox timing rather than a closed-form arithmetic rule.
sources.does_not_establish: an official, citable Iranian legal or standards text stating the civil calendar rule; that text was not retrieved

sources.authority: repository-pinned dependency, inspected locally (not an external authority)
sources.internal_roundtrip_check: 7304 consecutive Jalali dates (1385-01-01..1404-12-28) round-tripped Jalali->Gregorian->Jalali with 0 mismatches
sources.establishes: the library applies a fixed 33-year arithmetic approximation and is internally invertible over the checked range
sources.does_not_establish: that this approximation equals the official observational civil calendar, nor that the library is an authoritative calendar source

evidence_class_definitions.authoritative: primary text issued by the standard-setting or regulatory body that governs the field in question
evidence_class_definitions.authoritative_for_international_standard: primary standards text, but from a body that does not by itself define the CODAL field encoding this contract requires
evidence_class_definitions.secondary_supporting_not_authoritative: reference material used only to characterise a concept; never used to freeze a contract value
evidence_class_definitions.implementation_artifact_not_authoritativ: observed behaviour of software; never a substitute for a documented rule
evidence_class_definitions.access_failure: endpoint not reached; establishes nothing about the content that endpoint may hold

explicit_non_claims: No claim is made that CODAL lacks issuer-identifier documentation.
No claim is made that Iranian codified auditing standards do not exist or are unpublished.
No claim is made that CODAL lacks date-field format documentation.
No URL, identifier, standard, taxonomy, field name, date or source content in this manifest was invented; every unreachable endpoint is recorded as unreached rather than summarised.
Failure to locate documentation from this environment is not treated as proof that the documentation does not exist: absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.
